steps_en: Make the filling with 3/4 beef and 1/4 pork. Add onion, pepper, garlic and a little water. For juicier buuz, use at least 100 g of water. Make the dough as for pelmeni. Roll it out and cut rounds 10–15 cm in diameter. Place the filling in the center and pinch the dough into a pouch with an opening at the top. Steam the buuz for 15–25 minutes, depending on their size and filling.
The traditional dish is made with lamb or beef and pork. The source also mentions variants with horsemeat or game such as maral or bear, either alone or in a mixture.
